functions.name: PROB
functions.description: Blended probability (0-1) of a proposition, e.g. =EVENTRISK.PROB(A2) where A2 holds an id from EVENTRISK.PROPOSITIONS.

parameters.name: proposition_id
parameters.description: Proposition id (search for it in the Event Risk pane).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: the probability at that moment. Default now.

parameters.name: known_as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: only what the graph knew by then. Set equal to as_of for a backtest-safe value.

functions.name: CHANGE
functions.description: 24-hour change in a proposition's blended probability (e.g. 0.05 = +5 points).

parameters.name: known_as_of
parameters.description: Optional date/time: only what the graph knew by then.

functions.name: NAME
functions.description: The question a proposition asks, e.g. "Will China invade Taiwan before 2027?"

functions.name: PROPOSITIONS
functions.description: Spills a table of propositions (id, name, prob, 24h change, close time), biggest 24h movers first.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional text the proposition name must contain, e.g. "taiwan". Empty = all.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Optional entity id, e.g. "country:TW": only propositions involving it.

functions.name: EXPOSURES
functions.description: Spills the propositions a security is exposed to (id, name, prob, 24h change, score, path).

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Ticker as in the securities list, e.g. "TSM" or "BRK-B".

functions.name: HISTORY
functions.description: Spills a proposition's blended probability over time (date, prob, markets). Format the date column as a date.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Optional start date. Default 30 days before end.

functions.name: SCAN
functions.description: Portfolio scan: spills the propositions your holdings are most exposed to (id, name, prob, 24h change, exposure, moved, top holdings).

parameters.name: holdings
parameters.description: Two columns: ticker, weight (e.g. 0.05 for 5%). A header row is ignored.

parameters.name: move_threshold
parameters.description: Optional |24h change| that flags a proposition as moved. Default 0.05.
